# Project settings and editor preferences {#ch18}



## Where the settings are kept {#set_files}

Project settings are under **Edit** > **Project Settings** > **Plugins** > **FeelKit**. They are saved in the project's `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, in the section `[/Script/FeelCore.FeelSettings]`, so they are shared by everyone who works on the project and are packaged with the game.

Editor preferences are under **Edit** > **Editor Preferences** > **Plugins** > **FeelKit**. They belong to one user of one project and are saved in `Saved/Config/WindowsEditor/EditorPerProjectUserSettings.ini` on Windows.

## Camera {#set_camera}

[edition: Lite and Pro]

These settings decide how the camera output of separate plays combines for one player. Tracks inside one play always add up. With **Strongest Wins**, the strongest location offset, rotation offset and field of view change each win on their own. With **Additive Capped**, the plays add up and the sum is limited by the three caps.

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Camera Arbitration** | Strongest Wins | How overlapping camera effects combine. |
| **Max Camera Location Offset** | 30 cm | Largest combined camera location offset in additive mode. At least 0. Editable only when **Camera Arbitration** is **Additive Capped**. |
| **Max Camera Rotation Offset** | 8° | Largest combined camera rotation offset per axis in additive mode. At least 0. Editable only when **Camera Arbitration** is **Additive Capped**. |
| **Max Field Of View Offset** | 15° | Largest combined field of view change in additive mode. At least 0. Editable only when **Camera Arbitration** is **Additive Capped**. |

## Playback {#set_playback}

[edition: Lite and Pro]

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Blend Out Time** | 0.2 s | Fade-out length when a recipe is stopped with blend out. At least 0. |
| **Allow Global Time Dilation in Multiplayer** | Off | **Pro.** In networked games (client, listen server), world time is shared by everyone, so by default a Global Hitstop or global Slow-mo slows only the actors of the play (its target) on this machine instead of the whole world. Turn on to change world time anyway: on a listen server that slows every connected player, and on a client the server's time can override it. Single-player games always use world time. |
| **Accumulators** | empty | **Pro.** Named values that build up with repeated additions and decay over time. Recipe parameters can read them. |

Each entry of **Accumulators**:

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Name** | None | Name used to add to the value and to read it from recipe parameters. |
| **Max Value** | 1 | Highest value. Additions above it are clamped. At least 0. |
| **Decay Per Second** | 1 | How fast the value falls toward zero, in units per second. 0 keeps it until the game changes it. At least 0. |
| **Decay Delay** | 0 s | Seconds after the last addition before the value starts to fall. At least 0. |

## Events {#set_events}

[edition: Pro]

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Feel Maps** | empty | Feel Maps used by Send Feel Event for every target. A Feel Trigger component on the target can add maps that are checked first. |

## Comfort {#set_comfort}

[edition: Lite and Pro]

Players start with **Default Comfort Scales** until they change their settings or saved settings are loaded. **Channel Comfort Groups** decides which group scales each channel; a mapping covers the channel and every tag below it, and when several mappings match, the most specific tag wins.

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| >> Comfort |  |  |
| **Default Comfort Scales** | every scale 1 (see the comfort scale tables) | Comfort scales new players start with. Also the Default preset. |
| **Channel Comfort Groups** | nine entries (see the table below) | Which comfort group scales each channel. Child tags are included; the most specific tag wins. |
| **Comfort Menu Class** | FSoftClassPath(TEXT("/FeelKit/UI/WBP_FeelComfortMenu.WBP_FeelComfortMenu_C")) | Menu opened by Show Feel Comfort Menu when the node is given no menu class. To restyle the menu, copy WBP_FeelComfortMenu into your project (Copy to Project) and select the copy here. |
| **Apply Comfort to Engine Camera Shakes** | On | Applies each player's Camera Shake comfort scale (and Master) to camera shakes the game plays through the engine, not only to FeelKit recipes, so one comfort setting reduces every shake. |
| **Apply Comfort to Engine Force Feedback** | On | Applies each player's Haptics comfort scale (and Master) to all controller vibration through the player controller's force feedback scale, not only to FeelKit recipes. |
| >> Comfort > Presets |  |  |
| **Reduced Motion Preset** | see the comfort scale tables | Scales applied by the Reduced Motion preset. |
| **Reduced Flashing Preset** | see the comfort scale tables | Scales applied by the Reduced Flashing preset. |
| **No Haptics Preset** | see the comfort scale tables | Scales applied by the No Haptics preset. |

Each entry of **Channel Comfort Groups**:

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Channel** | None | Channel tag, for example Feel.Camera.Shake. Child tags are included. |
| **Group** | None | Comfort group that scales this channel. |

Default **Channel Comfort Groups**:

{widths: 55,45}
| Channel | Comfort group |
|---|---|
| `Feel.Camera.Shake` | Camera Shake |
| `Feel.Camera.Motion` | Camera Motion |
| `Feel.Screen.Flash` | Flashes |
| `Feel.Screen.Distortion` | Screen Distortion |
| `Feel.Screen.Color` | Screen Distortion |
| `Feel.Actor.Light` | Flashes |
| `Feel.Time.Hitstop` | Hitstop and Slow-mo |
| `Feel.Time.SlowMo` | Hitstop and Slow-mo |
| `Feel.Haptics` | Haptics |

Channels with no entry are scaled by Master only: `Feel.Actor.Material`, `Feel.Actor.Transform`, `Feel.Audio`, `Feel.Audio.Mix`, `Feel.Meta.Event`, `Feel.Meta.Recipe`, `Feel.Screen.Fade`, `Feel.Spawn`, `Feel.UI`.

## Comfort scale fields and preset values {#set_comfort_scales}

[edition: Lite and Pro]

Fields of a set of comfort scales (used by **Default Comfort Scales**, the three presets and custom Feel Comfort Preset assets):

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| >> Comfort |  |  |
| **Master** | 1 | Scales every effect. Range 0 to 1. |
| **Camera Shake** | 1 | Scales camera shakes. Range 0 to 1. |
| **Camera Motion** | 1 | Scales camera punches, FOV kicks, roll and zoom. Range 0 to 1. |
| **Flashes** | 1 | Scales full-screen flashes. Range 0 to 1. |
| **Hitstop and Slow-mo** | 1 | Scales hitstops and slow motion. Range 0 to 1. |
| **Screen Distortion** | 1 | Scales vignette, chromatic aberration and other distortion. Range 0 to 1. |
| **Haptics** | 1 | Scales controller vibration. Range 0 to 1. |
| >> Flash Limiter |  |  |
| **Limit Flashes** | On | Limits how many flashes can start in a short time. Counts FeelKit tracks on channels mapped to the Flashes group. A mitigation helper, not a photosensitivity certification: test your game with an analysis tool. |
| **Max Flashes Per Second** | 3 | Flashes allowed per second before the limiter acts. Values below 1 allow one flash per 1 / value seconds. Range 0.1 to 30. Editable only when **Limit Flashes** is on. |
| **Flash Limit Mode** | Soften | What happens to flashes above the allowed rate. Editable only when **Limit Flashes** is on. |
| **Softened Flash Scale** | 0.3 | Strength of softened flashes. Range 0 to 1. Editable only when **Limit Flashes** is on and **Flash Limit Mode** is **Soften**. |
| >> Motion |  |  |
| **Allow Camera Roll** | On | Allows FeelKit to roll the camera. Off removes camera roll from every recipe. |
| **Max Field Of View Change Per Second** | 0°/s | Fastest field of view change FeelKit may cause, in degrees per second. 0 is unlimited. At least 0. |

Values of the presets as FeelKit ships them. Each preset replaces all fields at once, so a field a preset does not change keeps the value shown in the Default column.

{widths: 32,17,17,17,17}
| Field | Default | Reduced Motion | Reduced Flashing | No Haptics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Master** | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| **Camera Shake** | 1 | 0.25 | 1 | 1 |
| **Camera Motion** | 1 | 0.25 | 1 | 1 |
| **Flashes** | 1 | 1 | 0.2 | 1 |
| **Hitstop and Slow-mo** | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| **Screen Distortion** | 1 | 0.5 | 1 | 1 |
| **Haptics** | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| **Limit Flashes** | On | On | On | On |
| **Max Flashes Per Second** | 3 | 3 | 1 | 3 |
| **Flash Limit Mode** | Soften | Soften | Suppress | Soften |
| **Softened Flash Scale** | 0.3 | 0.3 | 0.3 | 0.3 |
| **Allow Camera Roll** | On | Off | On | On |
| **Max Field Of View Change Per Second** | 0°/s | 40°/s | 0°/s | 0°/s |

## Comfort storage {#set_comfort_storage}

[edition: Lite and Pro]

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Auto Save Comfort** | On | Save automatically whenever a player's comfort settings change. |
| **Comfort Save Slot Prefix** | `FeelComfort` | Save slot prefix for the default storage. The local player index is appended. |
| **Comfort Storage Class** | None | Storage for comfort settings, implementing Feel Comfort Storage. Empty uses one save game slot per local player. |

## Editor preferences {#set_editor}

[edition: Lite and Pro]

{widths: 26,20,54}
| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| >> Timeline |  |  |
| **Snap to Frames** | On | Snap timeline edits to whole frames. |
| **Snap Frame Rate** | 60 | Frame rate used for snapping. Range 1 to 240. |
| >> Library |  |  |
| **Allow Library Editing** | Off | Allows editing and saving the recipes that ship with FeelKit (/FeelKit/Library). They are read-only by default, because the plugin is shared by every project on this engine: copy a library recipe into your project instead (right-click in the Content Browser, FeelKit, Recipe from Template). Turn this on only to author the library itself. |
